_doc: Schema for claude/cycles/<cycle_id>/execution_state/EPIC-xx.json — the per-EPIC execution state mechanism (Option 1), replacing the legacy single shared execution_state.json write surface. Each EPIC branch owns exactly one file under this path and never writes any other EPIC's file. Introduced by ST-19 (BLG-GOV-284, cycle 2026-08-03__release-v8.1). See claude/system/shared_standards.md §12 for the merge-sequencing convention this mechanism replaces (Rule 2 retired).
_regeneration_note: The cycle-level claude/cycles/<cycle_id>/execution_state.json file is now a COMPUTED SUMMARY, regenerated on demand by claude/system/scripts/generate_execution_summary.py from all execution_state/EPIC-*.json files present in the cycle folder. It is never hand-edited and never hand-merged — a git conflict on it is resolved by re-running the generator, not by manual reconciliation. Downstream consumers (Delivery Verification, Post-Ship Closure) continue reading claude/cycles/<cycle_id>/execution_state.json unchanged.
